mandatory_fences.requirement: New versioned mobile ADR/contract before enabling integration
mandatory_fences.detail: Preserve ADR002/003 historical DEFERRED bytes. Record selected Android API/targetSDK and iOS deploymentSDK/capture route, pinned native SDK/licenses/checksums and media-protocol compatibility. No main/latest dependency accepted by this entry.

Existing host/current18+/room/member/socket-generation/scope+20slease/5srenewal/protected epoch/revocation checks remain. Define native credential handoff, headers and background authority ownership explicitly; no direct SFU/admin endpoint or service signing secret, no browser session cookie/token in URL/deeplink/log/shared world-readable file.

Android fresh system projection consent + foreground service and playback capture only; iOS selected system picker/broadcast route. No microphone/camera substitution for missing app audio. Handle denied/noaudio/blocked/sourceended/background/OSstop/extensiondeath/processdeath/networkchange; stop current scope, never revive old grant, require new OS consent when needed.

mandatory_fences.requirement: Default native publication unavailable until qualified
mandatory_fences.detail: Server allowlist by protocol/platform/native-build capability, not untrusted version text as sole authority. Unknown/incompatible builds denied. UI states code-prepared/unverified and unsupported combinations; desktop/browser participation keeps its existing qualified scope.

Current APP_ORIGIN/ICE127.0.0.1 cannot serve physical phones. Define explicit privateLAN address, trusted scoped TLS hostname/certificate, mediaadvertisedIP/ports and firewall; no global TLS bypass, arbitrary ingress or externalSFU implied. PhysicalLAN profile is new NOT_RUN evidence, not reuse of internalDocker success.

Record exact appartifact/digest, server/core/SDK/OS/device/source and signatures; devkeys marked nonrelease, real signing material offGit/image/logs. Retire protected native leases and confirm cutoff, deny bad publisher version, preserve additivestate/ledgers and desktop safety; installed clients are not recalled by a store update.

mandatory_fences.requirement: Exit requires independent actual device evidence for both platforms
mandatory_fences.detail: Per declared tuple, real publisher→7viewers AV, permissions/stop/revoke/background/termination/reconnect/networkchange and bounded latency/CPU/battery/thermal profile fixed before tests. No emulated/browser/mock/source-only PASS substituted. No fullG4 until both supported platform scopes and distribution/compatibility gates are demonstrated.
